title: Photolysis lifetimes at 1 AU of the species a comet or an atmosphere loses to the stellar far ultraviolet
basis: Optically thin, unshielded, 1 AU from the quiet Sun. beta = 1/lifetime_s is photodissociation plus photoionisation; beta_diss and beta_ion are Heays 2017 (Leiden database) rates times 37692 for the quiet-period solar field. ratio_4000k and ratio_10000k are the dissociation rate around a 4000 K and a 10000 K blackbody divided by the solar rate at equal 91.2 to 200 nm flux (Heays 2017 Table 18, COMPUTED); the Sun is 1.
source: docs/design/body-composition-parts/G1-comets.md sections G1.2, 2.1 and 2.2; docs/design/atmosphere-composition.md (NH3 settled value)

H2O.lifetime_source: Huebner and Mukherjee 2015 quiet Sun (as coded in sbpy); range up to the unshielded Heays 2017 total
H2O.activity_source: Huebner and Mukherjee 2015: 8.294e4 s quiet, 4.939e4 s active (sbpy)

CO.lifetime_source: Crovisier and Encrenaz 1983 quiet Sun; de Val-Borro 2013 Table 2 gives 1.54e6; Heays 2017 total 1.83e6

CO2.lifetime_source: Huebner and Mukherjee 2015 quiet Sun (as coded in sbpy); the Heays 2017 total is 1.2e6
CO2.activity_source: Huebner and Mukherjee 2015: 4.95e5 s quiet, 2.10e5 s active (sbpy)

CH4.lifetime_source: Heays 2017 total; Jackson 1976 Table 1 gives 1.2e5 (exponent partly lost in the scan)
CH4.activity_source: not given: the active Sun shortens lifetimes by about 1.7 to 2.4 in general, no CH4 value was read

C2H6.lifetime_source: Heays 2017 total; no comet table found, uncertainty a factor 2

NH3.lifetime_source: Biver 2007 (Odin) 6700 s; Hatchell 2005 5.4e3 to 5.8e3; Engel and Wyckoff 1991 7.0e3 to 7.7e3; Heays 2017 rate 1.5e-4 per s with the Liang 2007 cross section reproduces 6.7e3 s
NH3.activity_source: 1.05 to 1.10 because NH3 absorbs mainly at 170 to 217 nm (settled with the body lane)
NH3.note: the 5.6e3 s of Huebner 1992 is a quiet and active mean, not the quiet Sun

HCN.lifetime_source: Crovisier 1994 via de Val-Borro 2013 (beta0 1.5e-5 per s); the Heays 2017 total is 1.22e5
HCN.activity_source: a search snippet puts the range at 3.2e4 to 7.7e4 s over solar activity (Huebner 1992, not read): 6.7e4 / 3.2e4

CH3OH.lifetime_source: Crovisier 1994 via de Val-Borro 2013 (1.3e-5 per s); the Heays 2017 total is 1.17e5

CH2O.lifetime_source: Crovisier 1994 via de Val-Borro 2013 (2.0e-4 per s, as a parent); the Heays 2017 total is 5.19e3

H2S.lifetime_source: Heays 2017 total; no comet table found, uncertainty a factor 2

N2.lifetime_source: Heays 2017 total; no comet table found, uncertainty a factor 2; unshielded (CO and N2 self-shield in a dense coma)
